notes.title: Major End-of-Month Update + New Game "Nice City" Page Live - Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

At the end of this month, during the National Day holiday, Campus Fantasy will get a major update! This update will mainly conclude the main storyline. Thanks for your continuous support!

Additionally, my new game "Nice City" store page is now live! Hope you can wishlist it.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4028160/_/

My new game is a 3D open-world RPG with multiplayer support, featuring an engaging story and characters from Campus Fantasy and Return to Campus (like Xiao Hei) who travel through time. Scheduled for release in Q1 2026.

Thanks again for all your support!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45390979/1f01492813c6eed4a6d81efa7315bd6629dd3db6.png[/img]

Nie Yuxing

notes.title: 游戏优化以及细节优化
notes.content: [p]1.现在游戏支持了FSR3技术，A卡玩家现在进游戏打开FSR3会流畅很多 2.优化了一些任务提示，比如去和琳琳看电影主线时候卡退，提示可以坐地铁前往[/p]

notes.title: bug修复以及游戏优化
notes.content: [p]1.大幅度优化了游戏整体帧率，对路人NPC之类采用多线程处理，减少了CPU瓶颈。[/p][p]2.修复了穷孩子研究筋斗云和飞行模式的研究界面关闭按钮不明显的问题[/p][p]3.修复了恐怖游戏无法开灯的问题[/p][p]4.目前为止修复了大大小小的bug和一些小内容改动，下次更新应该就是新内容的增加了，欢迎再次游玩！[/p]

notes.title: bug修复
notes.content:
[p]1.修复了琳琳跟随时如果主角跑的太远琳琳跟丢后重新让琳琳跟随失效的问题[/p][p]2.修复了白宫部分地面模型缺失碰撞的问题[/p][p]3.修复了发布政策的时候手臂和膝盖有穿模的情况[/p][p]4.修复了部分玩家开始场景会崩溃的问题（如果还崩请更新系统和显卡驱动）
5.赠送100万美金的场景增加了主角和琳琳的领奖[/p]

notes.title: bug修复
notes.content: [p]1.彻底修复了好了富孩子会被老师打电话的问题[/p][p]2.修复了召唤车辆，马匹无法交互的问题，并且交通工具都缺失碰撞[/p][p]3.修复了脱离卡死有时候会失效的问题[/p][p]4.修复了超人模式下激光眼射小黑，会被小黑肘死的问题[/p][p]5.超人提示现在会额外提示看左上角的操作详情，部分人未发现该功能，导致一些超能力都未曾使用[/p]

notes.title: Content updates and bug fixes
notes.content: [p]1. Fixed the issue that rich children from being late for class would be punished for standing[/p][p][/p][p]2. Newly added Superman mode, you can press the R key to pee while riding the somersault cloud[/p][p][/p][p]3. Fixed the poor child's version of being attacked by security guards when time is stationary[/p][p]4. Optimized the prompt for buying a car, prompting the mobile phone key and summoning the car[/p][p][/p][p]5. Fixed a bug where a rich kid would drop out of the map if he teleported directly from school to the 4S store to buy props[/p][p][/p][p]6. Fixed a bug where a rich kid doesn't need to buy a property to get into the property directly[/p][p][/p][p]7. Optimized the interpolation of the 50 series, and now the 50 series interpolation supports 4 times the interpolation of the frame[/p][p][/p][p]8. Added a new main story of Xiao Hei buying an airplane, and there will be a prompt to buy things in the future[/p][p][/p][p]9. Fixed a bug where taking the subway back to school from the theater would turn into a poor kid[/p][p][/p][p]10. Added that throwing money will attract students around you, and follow the protagonist to move[/p][p][/p][p]11. The full crowdfunding list has been added to the thank you list[/p]

notes.title: 内容更新以及bug修复
notes.content:
[p]1.更改了富孩子出身回学校必须坐地铁，现在能打开地图直接从城市传送到学校[/p][p]2.修复了收枪以后无法右键攻击的问题[/p][p]3.更改了富孩子不能在4s店买东西的问题，现在可以购买房产，以及时间静止装置[/p][p]4.修复了4s店给小黑买飞机剧情结束以后卡死的问题[/p][p]5.修复了过场动画中会有莫名其妙的NPC被攻击的音效[/p][p]6.修复了总统办公室有不明阻挡的问题，现在可以自由移动[/p][p]7.字幕修复为了默认开启[/p][p]8.修复了解密游戏角色无法跳跃[/p][p]9.修改了穷孩子研究超人模式和筋斗云条件不足的描述问题改为了分数和金钱提示[/p][p]10.优化了穷孩子后期的购物种类，现在可以去4s店购买时间静止装置，ak47，还有跑车，马匹之类。
11.修复了拿枪射击时地图传送会导致卡成第一人称的bug[/p]

notes.title: Subsequent update plan
notes.content: [b]Dear players, many people have reported that the Rich Child version is too short and not enough to play, so the playability is a little bit worse, so I decided to add another hour of main storyline and add a new love line. Later, I will improve the ending of the Poor Child storyline, increasing the storyline from four chapters to six. Please wait for a while, the update content will come soon. [/b]

notes.title: Title: Urgently update a version
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I have urgently updated a version. Except for the love system, everything else is available. The complete process is not affected. I will update the love version again after fixing the crash bug. Thank you for your support.

Nie Yuxing

notes.title: Officially on sale!
notes.content:
Dear friends, the official version is finally on sale! The first release is only 40% off! This is a one-person production, so please forgive me for some minor problems! If you encounter any problems, please give me feedback:

Because there are some bugs in other languages, it will not be supported on the first day of release. I will hurry up to solve the localization problem, and will support it as soon as possible after it is solved.

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: officially released on July 12! The price will be significantly reduced！
notes.content:
Dear brothers,
“Campus Fantasy” will be released soon! Thank you for your continued support, so I can make the game.
According to the feedback from some brothers, they think the price is too expensive, so it will be cheaper. The initial price will be set at $5.99. For brothers who have purchased the “bro support” pack, the price will be $3.3.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380110/_/

Thank you for your continued support! I have listened to your opinions and love you.

Nie Yuxing
